parameters.name: DealAll
parameters.description:
The identity is simultaneous processing of servers that have the same process. Valid values:
- **0**: Do not use simultaneous processing.
- **1**: Use simultaneous processing.

parameters.name: OperateInfo
parameters.description: The operation parameters for batch setting the tamper-proofing process status. The value is in JSON format.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the tamper-proofing process. Valid values:
- **0**: Remove from the whitelist.
- **1**: Add to the whitelist.

parameters.name: Uuid
parameters.description: The UUID of the server for which you want to set the tamper-proofing process status.
